comment: Recorded shape of the #787 leak (parent spec #796): PR #787 was dispatched
for story #767 (Porntrex S1 evidence) and ended up carrying story #771's
commit 689ea1f17817) plus docs/skill edits that belong to other stories.
The story numbers, branch names and file paths below are the real ones from
that PR's commit list, so the sim reproduces the recorded evidence rather

A.title: [impl] Porntrex quality mapping — S1: pinned-API + live evidence note

cases.name: cross-pr-rewrite
cases.what: aw_context was rewritten to story A while the furnished PR/branch is story B's — a repair for A would push into B's PR (root cause candidate 3 in #796).

cases.name: sibling-findings-same-branch
cases.what: branch/PR identity is A's, but story B's findings and deliverable sit in the worktree (the recorded #787 third commit). The identity guard alone cannot catch this — the merge-scope rule must drop the sibling deliverable and never import its notes.

lines.text: - S1 quality mapping: every compound label maps to Unknown(400); S2 mapping table decided.
- S2 rule (imported from #771/#792): inline the bare-NNNp/4k grammar in the mapping function.

cases.name: branch-without-issue-segment
cases.what: the target branch carries no devloop/issue-<n>- segment, so the primary assertion cannot hold — the guard must fail closed.

cases.name: clean-story-scope
cases.what: happy path: identity matches and only A's own deliverables are staged — the guard must not block a legitimate push.
